methods.name: GetPivot
methods.doc: The frame the instance moves and turns about: a part's CFrame, or a model's pivot.

methods.name: PivotTo
methods.doc: Moves the instance so that its pivot lands on the given frame; a model's parts move together, keeping their offsets.

properties.name: PrimaryPart
properties.doc: The part whose frame is the model's pivot, or nil.

properties.name: WorldPivot
properties.note: Without a primary part the pivot is the bounding-box centre; a pivot set by a script is not stored.
properties.doc: The model's pivot in the world: the primary part's frame, or the centre of the model's bounding box when it has none. Setting it without a primary part moves only the pivot.

methods.name: GetBoundingBox
methods.doc: The frame and size of the box around every part in the model, aligned with the pivot's rotation.

methods.name: GetExtentsSize
methods.doc: The size of the box around every part in the model.

methods.name: MoveTo
methods.note: Does not step up over parts in the way.
methods.doc: Moves the model so its pivot is at the given position, keeping its rotation.

methods.name: TranslateBy
methods.doc: Moves every part of the model by the given offset.

methods.name: SetPrimaryPartCFrame
methods.doc: Moves the model so its primary part lands on the frame.

methods.name: GetPrimaryPartCFrame
methods.doc: The primary part's frame.

classes.name: BasePart
classes.doc: A solid block of the 3D world that can be simulated, collide, be touched and be found by queries.

properties.name: Size
properties.doc: The part's dimensions in studs along its own X, Y and Z axes. Each is at least 0.001.

properties.name: Anchored
properties.doc: When true the part does not move by physics; it still collides and can be moved by scripts.

properties.name: CanCollide
properties.doc: When false other parts pass through this one.

properties.name: CanQuery
properties.doc: When false, and the part does not collide, spatial queries do not see it.

properties.name: CanTouch
properties.doc: When false the part fires no Touched or TouchEnded events.

properties.name: Massless
properties.doc: When true the part adds no mass to its assembly, unless it is the assembly's root.

properties.name: Material
properties.doc: The part's material; it sets the default density, friction and elasticity.

properties.name: CollisionGroup
properties.doc: The name of the collision group the part belongs to (see PhysicsService).

properties.name: RootPriority
properties.doc: The part with the highest value becomes its assembly's root, after anchored parts.

properties.name: CFrame
properties.doc: The part's position and rotation in the world.

properties.name: Position
properties.doc: The part's position in the world.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.doc: The part's rotation in degrees about X, Y and Z, applied in Y, X, Z order.

properties.name: Rotation
properties.doc: The part's rotation in degrees about X, Y and Z, applied in X, Y, Z order.

properties.name: CustomPhysicalProperties
properties.note: Kept while the place runs; not saved with the scene. Setting it back to nil from a script is refused.
properties.doc: Physical properties that replace the material's, or nil to use the material's.

properties.name: CurrentPhysicalProperties
properties.doc: The physical properties in effect: the custom ones, or the material's.

properties.name: Mass
properties.doc: The part's own mass: density times volume.

properties.name: AssemblyLinearVelocity
properties.doc: The velocity of the assembly's centre of mass, in studs per second. Setting it changes the whole assembly's velocity.

properties.name: AssemblyAngularVelocity
properties.doc: The assembly's angular velocity in radians per second.

properties.name: AssemblyMass
properties.note: An anchored assembly reads 0 rather than the sum of its parts' masses.
properties.doc: The total mass of the parts in the assembly (0 for an anchored assembly).

properties.name: AssemblyCenterOfMass
properties.doc: The centre of mass of the assembly in the world.

properties.name: AssemblyRootPart
properties.doc: The root part of the assembly the part belongs to.

properties.name: Velocity
properties.doc: The assembly's linear velocity.

properties.name: RotVelocity
properties.doc: The assembly's angular velocity.

methods.name: ApplyImpulse
methods.doc: Adds an impulse at the assembly's centre of mass.

methods.name: ApplyImpulseAtPosition
methods.doc: Adds an impulse at a point in the world, which can also turn the assembly.

methods.name: ApplyAngularImpulse
methods.doc: Adds an angular impulse to the assembly.

methods.name: GetMass
methods.doc: The part's own mass.

methods.name: GetRootPart
methods.doc: The root part of the part's assembly.

methods.name: GetConnectedParts
methods.doc: The parts joined to this one by welds and joints; with recursive true, every part reachable through them.

methods.name: GetJoints
methods.doc: The welds, joints and constraints attached to this part or its attachments.

methods.name: IsGrounded
methods.doc: True when the part is anchored or joined to an anchored part.

methods.name: GetTouchingParts
methods.doc: The parts this part is touching now.

methods.name: GetVelocityAtPosition
methods.doc: The velocity of the point of the assembly at the given world position.

methods.name: CanCollideWith
methods.doc: True if the two parts' collision groups collide and both parts collide.

methods.name: BreakJoints
methods.doc: Destroys the welds and joints attached to the part.

events.name: Touched
events.doc: Fires when another part starts touching this one, if both can touch.

events.name: TouchEnded
events.doc: Fires when another part stops touching this one.

classes.name: Part
classes.doc: A basic part: a block, ball, cylinder, wedge or corner wedge.

properties.name: Shape
properties.doc: The part's shape. A ball's diameter is its smallest dimension; a cylinder lies along X.

classes.name: WedgePart
classes.doc: A wedge: a block cut diagonally, sloping up from its front bottom edge to its back top edge.

classes.name: CornerWedgePart
classes.doc: A corner wedge: a pyramid-like part with its apex above one corner.

classes.name: TrussPart
classes.note: Climbing is not built; it collides as a block.
classes.doc: A lattice beam. It collides as a block.

classes.name: SpawnLocation
classes.note: The properties are stored; spawning characters here belongs to the character work.
classes.doc: A part where characters appear.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false characters do not spawn here.

properties.name: Neutral
properties.doc: When true any player may spawn here.

properties.name: AllowTeamChangeOnTouch
properties.doc: When true touching it moves a player to its team.

properties.name: Duration
properties.doc: Seconds of protection a spawned character gets.

classes.name: Terrain
classes.note: Always empty: no voxels, water or terrain methods.
classes.doc: The place's voxel terrain. It is always empty here.

classes.name: Camera
classes.note: This file declares the class; its properties come with the rendering work.
classes.doc: A viewpoint in the 3D world. Workspace.CurrentCamera is the one the place is seen through.

methods.name: Raycast
methods.note: IgnoreWater has no effect: there is no terrain water.
methods.doc: Casts a ray from origin along direction (its length is the reach) and returns the first part it enters, or nil. Parts the ray starts inside are not hit.

methods.name: Blockcast
methods.doc: Sweeps a box along direction and returns the first part it meets, or nil. Parts the box starts in are not hit.

methods.name: Spherecast
methods.doc: Sweeps a ball along direction and returns the first part it meets, or nil. Parts the ball starts in are not hit.

methods.name: Shapecast
methods.doc: Sweeps the shape of a part along direction and returns the first other part it meets, or nil.

methods.name: GetPartBoundsInBox
methods.doc: The parts whose bounding boxes overlap the given box.

methods.name: GetPartBoundsInRadius
methods.doc: The parts whose bounding boxes overlap the given ball.

methods.name: GetPartsInPart
methods.doc: The parts whose shapes overlap the shape of the given part.

methods.name: BulkMoveTo
methods.note: The event mode is ignored: CFrame change events fire as for single moves.
methods.doc: Moves many parts to their frames at once.

methods.name: FindPartOnRay
methods.doc: Casts a ray and returns the part hit, the point, the normal and the material.

properties.name: Gravity
properties.doc: Downward acceleration in studs per second squared.

properties.name: FallenPartsDestroyHeight
properties.doc: Unanchored parts that fall below this height are destroyed.

properties.name: CurrentCamera
properties.note: The camera's own properties come with the rendering work.
properties.doc: The camera the place is seen through. A Camera is made under the workspace when there is none.

properties.name: Terrain
properties.doc: The place's terrain, made when first read. It is always empty.

classes.name: PhysicsService
classes.note: Groups registered while the place runs are not saved with the scene.
classes.doc: Keeps the collision groups: named sets of parts and which sets collide with which.

methods.name: RegisterCollisionGroup
methods.doc: Adds a collision group that collides with every group. Up to 32 groups exist, Default included.

methods.name: UnregisterCollisionGroup
methods.doc: Removes a collision group; its parts behave as Default.

methods.name: RenameCollisionGroup
methods.doc: Renames a collision group; parts naming the old name behave as Default until renamed.

methods.name: CollisionGroupSetCollidable
methods.doc: Sets whether parts of two groups collide.

methods.name: CollisionGroupsAreCollidable
methods.doc: Whether parts of two groups collide.

methods.name: GetRegisteredCollisionGroups
methods.doc: One table per group, with name and mask fields.

methods.name: IsCollisionGroupRegistered
methods.doc: Whether a group of that name exists.

methods.name: GetMaxCollisionGroups
methods.doc: The most groups there can be (32).

methods.name: CreateCollisionGroup
methods.doc: Adds a group and returns its id.

methods.name: RemoveCollisionGroup
methods.doc: Removes a group.

methods.name: GetCollisionGroupId
methods.doc: The id of a group.

methods.name: GetCollisionGroupName
methods.doc: The name of a group id.

methods.name: SetPartCollisionGroup
methods.doc: Puts a part in a group.

classes.name: Attachment
classes.doc: A frame fixed to a part, which constraints and movers attach to.

properties.name: CFrame
properties.doc: The attachment's frame relative to its parent part.

properties.name: Visible
properties.doc: When true the attachment is drawn in tools.

properties.name: Position
properties.doc: The attachment's position relative to its parent part.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.doc: The attachment's rotation relative to its parent part, in degrees.

properties.name: Axis
properties.doc: The attachment's X axis relative to its parent part.

properties.name: SecondaryAxis
properties.doc: The attachment's Y axis relative to its parent part.

properties.name: WorldCFrame
properties.doc: The attachment's frame in the world.

properties.name: WorldPosition
properties.doc: The attachment's position in the world.

properties.name: WorldOrientation
properties.doc: The attachment's rotation in the world, in degrees.

properties.name: WorldAxis
properties.doc: The attachment's X axis in the world.

properties.name: WorldSecondaryAxis
properties.doc: The attachment's Y axis in the world.

classes.name: JointInstance
classes.doc: A joint that holds Part1 at a fixed offset from Part0.

properties.name: Part0
properties.doc: The first part.

properties.name: Part1
properties.doc: The second part, held at Part0.CFrame * C0 * C1:Inverse().

properties.name: C0
properties.doc: The joint's frame relative to Part0.

properties.name: C1
properties.doc: The joint's frame relative to Part1.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false the joint holds nothing.

properties.name: Active
properties.doc: True while the joint holds its parts: enabled, with both parts in the workspace.

classes.name: Weld
classes.doc: A rigid joint: Part1 stays at Part0.CFrame * C0 * C1:Inverse().

classes.name: ManualWeld
classes.doc: A weld made by hand in an editor; it behaves as a Weld.

classes.name: Snap
classes.doc: A rigid joint left by older tools; it behaves as a Weld.

classes.name: Motor
classes.note: The angle is held; it does not turn toward DesiredAngle.
classes.doc: A joint that turns Part1 about C0's Z axis toward DesiredAngle.

properties.name: DesiredAngle
properties.note: Stored; the motor does not turn toward it.
properties.doc: The angle the motor turns toward, in radians.

properties.name: MaxVelocity
properties.doc: How far the motor may turn per step, in radians.

properties.name: CurrentAngle
properties.doc: The motor's angle, in radians.

classes.name: Motor6D
classes.doc: A joint that animations drive: Part1 stays at Part0.CFrame * C0 * Transform * C1:Inverse().

properties.name: Transform
properties.doc: The animated offset between C0 and C1.

classes.name: WeldConstraint
classes.doc: Holds two parts at the offset they had when it was joined, or when either part was last moved by a script.

properties.name: Part0
properties.doc: The first part.

properties.name: Part1
properties.doc: The second part.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false the parts move independently.

properties.name: Active
properties.doc: True while the weld holds its parts.

classes.name: Constraint
classes.doc: Joins two attachments with a rule or a force.

properties.name: Attachment0
properties.doc: The first attachment.

properties.name: Attachment1
properties.doc: The second attachment.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false the constraint does nothing.

properties.name: Visible
properties.doc: When true the constraint is drawn in tools.

properties.name: Active
properties.doc: True while the constraint acts: enabled, with its attachments on parts in the workspace.

classes.name: BallSocketConstraint
classes.note: Restitution and friction torque are stored only.
classes.doc: Keeps two attachments at the same point, letting them turn, within optional angle limits.

properties.name: LimitsEnabled
properties.doc: When true the angle between the attachments' X axes stays within UpperAngle.

properties.name: UpperAngle
properties.doc: The largest angle between the X axes, in degrees.

properties.name: TwistLimitsEnabled
properties.doc: When true the twist about X stays between the twist angles.

properties.name: TwistLowerAngle
properties.doc: The lowest twist, in degrees.

properties.name: TwistUpperAngle
properties.doc: The highest twist, in degrees.

properties.name: Restitution
properties.doc: Bounciness at the limits.

properties.name: MaxFrictionTorque
properties.doc: Torque that resists turning.

classes.name: HingeConstraint
classes.note: Motor acceleration limits and restitution are stored only.
classes.doc: Lets two attachments turn about their shared X axis, freely, as a motor or as a servo.

properties.name: ActuatorType
properties.doc: None, Motor or Servo.

properties.name: AngularVelocity
properties.doc: The motor's target speed, radians per second.

properties.name: MotorMaxTorque
properties.doc: The most torque the motor uses.

properties.name: MotorMaxAcceleration
properties.doc: The motor's acceleration limit.

properties.name: TargetAngle
properties.doc: The servo's target angle, degrees.

properties.name: AngularSpeed
properties.doc: The servo's turning speed, radians per second.

properties.name: ServoMaxTorque
properties.doc: The most torque the servo uses.

properties.name: LimitsEnabled
properties.doc: When true the angle stays between LowerAngle and UpperAngle.

properties.name: LowerAngle
properties.doc: The lowest angle, degrees.

properties.name: UpperAngle
properties.doc: The highest angle, degrees.

properties.name: Restitution
properties.doc: Bounciness at the limits.

properties.name: CurrentAngle
properties.doc: The hinge's angle now, in degrees.

classes.name: RopeConstraint
classes.note: Winches and restitution are stored only.
classes.doc: Keeps two attachments no further apart than Length.

properties.name: Length
properties.doc: The rope's length in studs.

properties.name: Restitution
properties.doc: Bounciness when the rope goes taut.

properties.name: WinchEnabled
properties.doc: When true a winch changes the length.

properties.name: CurrentDistance
properties.doc: The distance between the attachments now.

classes.name: RodConstraint
classes.doc: Keeps two attachments exactly Length apart.

properties.name: Length
properties.doc: The rod's length in studs.

properties.name: CurrentDistance
properties.doc: The distance between the attachments now.

classes.name: LinearVelocity
classes.note: Plane mode and force limit modes other than Magnitude are not built.
classes.doc: Drives the velocity of Attachment0's assembly toward a target, using at most MaxForce.

properties.name: VelocityConstraintMode
properties.note: Plane mode is not built: the constraint applies no force in it.
properties.doc: Vector drives the whole velocity; Line drives the velocity along LineDirection only.

properties.name: VectorVelocity
properties.doc: The target velocity in Vector mode.

properties.name: LineDirection
properties.doc: The direction of the line in Line mode.

properties.name: LineVelocity
properties.doc: The target speed along the line in Line mode.

properties.name: MaxForce
properties.doc: The most force used.

properties.name: ForceLimitsEnabled
properties.doc: When false the force is unlimited.

properties.name: RelativeTo
properties.doc: Whether the target is in world space or in the frame of an attachment.

classes.name: AngularVelocity
classes.doc: Drives the angular velocity of Attachment0's assembly toward a target, using at most MaxTorque.

properties.name: AngularVelocity
properties.doc: The target angular velocity, radians per second.

properties.name: MaxTorque
properties.doc: The most torque used.

properties.name: RelativeTo
properties.doc: Whether the target is in world space or in the frame of an attachment.

classes.name: AlignPosition
classes.note: Reaction forces on Attachment1's assembly are not applied.
classes.doc: Pulls Attachment0 toward Attachment1, or toward Position in one-attachment mode.

properties.name: Mode
properties.doc: OneAttachment aims at Position; TwoAttachment aims at Attachment1.

properties.name: Position
properties.doc: The target in one-attachment mode.

properties.name: MaxForce
properties.doc: The most force used.

properties.name: MaxVelocity
properties.doc: The fastest the attachment is pulled.

properties.name: Responsiveness
properties.doc: How quickly the attachment reaches the target; higher is quicker.

properties.name: RigidityEnabled
properties.doc: When true the attachment is pulled as hard and fast as the solver allows.

properties.name: ApplyAtCenterOfMass
properties.doc: When true the force acts at the assembly's centre of mass, so it does not turn it.

properties.name: ReactionForceEnabled
properties.doc: When true Attachment1's assembly is pulled back.

classes.name: AlignOrientation
classes.note: Primary-axis-only alignment and reaction torques are not built.
classes.doc: Turns Attachment0 toward the rotation of Attachment1, or toward CFrame in one-attachment mode.

properties.name: Mode
properties.doc: OneAttachment aims at CFrame; TwoAttachment aims at Attachment1.

properties.name: CFrame
properties.doc: The target rotation in one-attachment mode (its position is ignored).

properties.name: MaxTorque
properties.doc: The most torque used.

properties.name: MaxAngularVelocity
properties.doc: The fastest the attachment is turned.

properties.name: Responsiveness
properties.doc: How quickly the attachment reaches the target; higher is quicker.

properties.name: RigidityEnabled
properties.doc: When true the attachment is turned as hard and fast as the solver allows.

properties.name: PrimaryAxisOnly
properties.note: Stored only: all three axes align.
properties.doc: When true only the X axes are aligned.

properties.name: ReactionTorqueEnabled
properties.doc: When true Attachment1's assembly is turned back.

classes.name: VectorForce
classes.doc: Pushes Attachment0's assembly with a constant force.

properties.name: Force
properties.doc: The force.

properties.name: RelativeTo
properties.doc: Whether Force is in world space or in an attachment's frame.

properties.name: ApplyAtCenterOfMass
properties.doc: When true the force acts at the assembly's centre of mass, so it does not turn it.
